    u.c.p. maps for the CEP ultraproduct #

    Coordinate evaluation MatrixSeqAlg dim → MatrixAlg (dim k) as a unital *-hom (hence u.c.p.), and composition of completely positive maps (absent from Mathlib). These are the pieces the D2 estimate QuotientLiftCoordinateEstimates composes: the coordinate microstate is coordProjCP k ∘ Φ.

    source
    def ZFib.CEP.coordEvalStarAlgHom {dim : ℕ → ℕ} (k : ℕ) :
    ↥(MatrixSeqAlg dim) →⋆ₐ[ℂ] MatrixAlg (dim k)

    Coordinate evaluation MatrixSeqAlg dim → MatrixAlg (dim k) as a unital *-algebra hom. Pointwise operations on lp _ ∞ make x ↦ x k multiplicative, unital, additive and *-preserving.
